about: A chart bar before another series' first held row (a SERIES_UNKNOWN_BEFORE_FIRST series: our store's intraday depth of SP:SPX) is withheld BY NAME on the per-bar channel (other-symbol:before-held), with the bars within the tree's reach of one; the strip says why; holes after the first row and unmarked or gaps-read-na series are never named. Coordinator ruling 2026-11-22 (engine 94, rides train e94). Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.
